title: Unit 1 What do you do with money?

sections.title: 一、听力理解 (第一段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第一段对话,完成第1、2小题。

audio.text:
Boy: Hi, Amy! Do you often spend your pocket money on toys?
Girl: No, not really. I like to save my pocket money.
Boy: Then what do you usually do with it?
Girl: I buy books and share them with my classmates.
Boy: That's wise.

questions.translation: 女孩通常用她的零花钱做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Girl: I buy books and share them with my classmates.' 可知，女孩用零花钱买书并与同学分享。
questions.prompt: What does the girl usually do with her pocket money?

questions.translation: 男孩觉得女孩的方法怎么样？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Boy: That's wise.'（那是明智的）可知，男孩认为女孩的方法很明智/聪明。
questions.prompt: What does the boy think of the girl's way?

sections.title: 二、听力理解 (第二段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第二段对话,完成第3、4、5小题。

audio.text:
Boy: Is this your new notebook?
Girl: Yes. I bought it with my pocket money yesterday.
Boy: It's lovely. Did you buy anything else?
Girl: I also bought a new pencil case for my sister.
Boy: How much did you spend in total?
Girl: The notebook is 5 yuan and the pencil case is 15 yuan.
Boy: They are both nice and useful.

questions.translation: 女孩为她的姐姐/妹妹买了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Girl: I also bought a new pencil case for my sister.' 可知，她给姐姐买了一个新的铅笔盒。
questions.prompt: What did the girl buy for her sister?

questions.translation: 她总共花了多少钱？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'The notebook is 5 yuan and the pencil case is 15 yuan.' 可知，笔记本5元，铅笔盒15元，总共花费 5 + 15 = 20 元。
questions.prompt: How much did she spend in total (合计)?

questions.translation: 他们主要在谈论什么？
questions.explanation: 对话围绕用零花钱买笔记本和给妹妹买礼物展开，因此主题是用零花钱买东西。
questions.prompt: What are they mainly talking about?

sections.title: 四、听力判断 - Speed up
sections.instruction: 听短文,根据短文内容判断句子是否与所听到的内容一致,一致的在括号中用“T”表示,不一致的用“F”表示。

audio.text: Last Sunday, Danny walked to a gift shop near his home. He saw nice pens and colourful cards there, but he didn't buy them. He thought for a long time. At last, he used his pocket money to buy a warm scarf for his mum. His mum was very happy and felt proud of him.

questions.translation: 丹尼上周日去了一家礼品店。
questions.explanation: 听力原文明确指出：Last Sunday, Danny walked to a gift shop near his home.
questions.prompt: Danny went to a gift shop last Sunday.

questions.translation: 这家店在丹尼的学校附近。
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出商店在丹尼家附近（near his home），而不是学校附近。
questions.prompt: The shop was near Danny's school.

questions.translation: 丹尼在店里看到了好看的钢笔和五颜六色的卡片。
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为：He saw nice pens and colourful cards there.
questions.prompt: Danny saw nice pens and colourful cards in the shop.

questions.translation: 丹尼最后给他妈妈买了一条暖和的围巾。
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为：At last, he used his pocket money to buy a warm scarf for his mum.
questions.prompt: Danny bought a warm scarf for his mum at last.

questions.translation: 丹尼的妈妈为他感到骄傲。
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为：His mum was very happy and felt proud of him.
questions.prompt: Danny's mum felt proud of him.

sections.title: 五、故事排序
sections.instruction: 阅读寓言故事,根据内容给句子排序,将相应的数字标号填入题前括号内。(第一个答案已给出。)
sections.passage: A long time ago, there was a man who lived with his family in a small village. He had a special goose. Every morning, the goose laid (下蛋)one beautiful golden egg. The man sold the eggs and became rich. But he was not happy. He was very greedy(贪婪的) and wanted more gold. He thought there must be lots of gold inside the goose. So he decided to kill the goose to get all the gold at once. He picked up a knife and killed it quickly. However, when he cut open the goose, he found nothing inside. It was just like any other goose. He lost his wonderful goose forever and felt regretful (悔恨的).

questions.translation: 他卖掉金蛋并变得富有。
questions.explanation: 根据文章 'The man sold the eggs and became rich.' 发生在拥有会下金蛋的鹅之后，排在第2位。
questions.prompt: He sold the golden eggs and became rich.

questions.explanation: 根据文章 'He picked up a knife and killed it quickly.' 发生在决定获取所有金子之后，排在第4位。
questions.prompt: The man killed the goose with a knife.

questions.translation: 这个人发现鹅肚子里没有金子。
questions.explanation: 根据文章 'when he cut open the goose, he found nothing inside.' 发生在杀了鹅之后，排在第5位。
questions.prompt: The man found no gold inside the goose.

questions.translation: 这个人有一只神奇的会下金蛋的鹅。
questions.explanation: 根据文章开头 'The man had a special goose that laid golden eggs.' 这是故事的起点，已给出编号1。
questions.prompt: The man had a special goose that laid golden eggs.

questions.translation: 贪婪的人想要一次得到所有的金子。
questions.explanation: 根据文章 'He was very greedy and wanted more gold... So he decided to kill the goose' 排在第3位。

sections.title: 八、阅读理解 A - Managing Money
sections.instruction: 阅读文章,根据内容选择正确选项,将相应的标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
# Managing Money

Tom and Mia learn to manage(管理,经营) money with Uncle Tito's help. Mia wants to save for a new bike, but Tom often spends money on candy and toys. "Smart people spend, save, and give to help others," Uncle Tito tells them. Then they start a new plan.

First, they make a budget (预算). They write down how much money they get from pocket money, doing chores, and their lemonade stand (柠檬水售卖摊) near their home. This clear plan helps them know how much they can use each week.

Second, they learn about needs and wants. Needs are things they must have, like lemonade supplies, ice and cups. Wants are fun things they don't really need, such as candy and comic books. They stop spending too much on wants.

Third, they use simple ways to manage money. They look for low prices and things on sale to save more. They set small goals and save little by little. They also give some money to help people and animals in need.

At last, they divide their money into three parts: spend, save, and give. They stick to (坚持) their budget and become good at managing money wisely.

questions.translation: Mia想攒钱买什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第一段 'Mia wants to save for a new bike' 可知，Mia想攒钱买一辆新自行车。
questions.prompt: What does Mia want to save money for?

questions.translation: Tom和Mia为了管理金钱首先做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第二段 'First, they make a budget (预算).' 可知，他们首先做的是制定预算。
questions.prompt: What do Tom and Mia make first to manage money?

questions.translation: 以下哪一项是他们真正的需求（need）？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第三段 'Needs are things they must have, like lemonade supplies, ice and cups.' 可知柠檬水杯子和冰块是真正的需求。
questions.prompt: Which of the following is a real need for them?

questions.translation: 我们可以从文章中推断出什么？
questions.explanation: 文章开头提到 'Tom and Mia learn to manage money with Uncle Tito's help' 并说明了Tito叔叔教导他们如何合理花钱、存钱和捐赠，说明Tito叔叔教给他们很好的金钱习惯。
questions.prompt: What can we infer (推断) from the passage?
options: They never spend money on anything fun.
They give all their money to poor people.
Uncle Tito teaches them good money habits.

questions.translation: 故事的主旨大意是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章主要讲述了Tom和Mia在Tito叔叔的帮助下学会如何明智地管理金钱，对应选项B。
questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the story?
options: How to run (经营) a lemonade stand well.
How to buy expensive things cheaply.

sections.title: 九、阅读理解 B - Megan's Wonderful Trip
sections.instruction: 阅读文章,根据文章内容选择正确选项,将相应的标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
# Megan's Wonderful Trip

Megan liked collecting small things. But she often spent her pocket money on snacks and toys right away.

One day, she found her friend Kyle had more money. But they got the same pocket money every week.

"Why do you have more money than me?" Megan asked.

Kyle smiled and said, "I save my money in the bank, not just in a piggy bank(存钱罐)at home."

Megan felt surprised. She asked her mom for help. Her mom told her, "Saving a little bit over time is better than spending all your money quickly."

Megan decided to stop buying things she didn't really need. She put money into her piggy bank first. Then, with her parents' help, she opened a kids' bank account(账户). Her parents also helped her make a simple plan:

* Save a little money every week
* Give a little to help people in need
* Keep a little to spend on things she wants

Not long after that, Megan saved enough money for a family trip. She visited new places, learned many new things, and had a really wonderful time. On this trip, she learned that saving money in a smart way helps her stop wasting money and makes her dream trip come true.

questions.prompt: Why did Kyle have more money?

Because he got more pocket money.

questions.explanation: Megan的计划包括每周攒一点钱、捐一点钱以及留一点买自己想要的东西，而“把所有的钱都花在玩具上”与计划相违背。
questions.prompt: What is NOT in Megan's money plan?

questions.translation: 故事的主旨大意是什么？
questions.explanation: 故事主要讲述了Megan通过学习如何明智地使用和攒钱，最终实现了梦想之旅，对应选项B。
questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the story?
options: How to collect nice small things.
How to use and save money well.
How to have a free family trip.
